# `merv-client`

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/merv-client.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/merv-client)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/merv-client.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/node/v/merv-client.svg)](https://nodejs.org/)

**MERV (Metrics Engine for Reports & Visualization)** — JavaScript/TypeScript **core** client: **Merv-Local** HTML/JSON reports and server sync (same contract as the Java `merv-client`). Framework adapters live in separate packages:

| Package | Role |
|---------|------|
| **`merv-client`** (this package) | Core: local reports, server API, shared plugin steps, **Chai** |
| **`merv-client-playwright`** | [Full docs](../merv-client-playwright/README.md) — reporter, wrapped `test`, Cucumber page actions |
| **`merv-client-cucumber`** | [Full docs](../merv-client-cucumber/README.md) — formatter, `MervReporter` |

Old import paths (`merv-client/playwright-reporter`, `merv-client/cucumber-formatter`, `merv-client/chai`) still work via re-exports.

---

## Why this package?

| Capability | Description |
|------------|-------------|
| **Playwright reporter** | Writes `json/merv-report.json`, live suite HTML, and refreshes the report dashboard under `merv.report.folder`. |
| **Java-parity steps** | `MervPlaywrightHandler` + attach pipeline merge custom rows with Playwright’s own steps per testcase. |
| **Standalone reporting** | `MervReport.open()` emits the same folder layout **without** registering the reporter (no `TestInfo.attach` pipeline). |
| **`merv.properties`** | Same configuration style as the Java client (report path, suite title, screenshots, debug noise, extra step types). |

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install -D merv-client
```

**Peer dependency:** `@playwright/test` **≥ 1.30.0** (optional; only for Playwright projects)

**Runtime:** Node.js **≥ 18**

---

## Console logger (`MervLogger`)

```ts
import { MervLogger } from 'merv-client';

MervLogger.info('Suite started');
MervLogger.debug('User id={}', userId);
MervLogger.warn('Retrying request');
MervLogger.error('Checkout failed', err);
// Optional screenshot (path, PNG buffer, or data URL) → stored under log/screenshots/
MervLogger.info('Checkout page', { screenshot: await page.screenshot() });

const log = MervLogger.getLogger('CheckoutApi');
log.info('POST /checkout ok');

MervLogger.setLevel('DEBUG');           // TRACE | DEBUG | INFO | WARN | ERROR | OFF
MervLogger.configure({ color: true, timestamps: true });
```

Level (highest priority first): `MervLogger.setLevel` / `configure` → env `MERV_LOG_LEVEL` → `merv.logger.level` in `merv.properties`.

### Merv-Logs (live page)

By default each log line is appended under **`{merv.report.folder}/log/`** as 5-minute NDJSON files (`merv-YYYY-MM-DDTHH-mm.ndjson`).

```bash
npx merv show-report
# open http://127.0.0.1:6174/merv-logs.html
# or click **Merv-Logs** in the dashboard sidebar
# or open logs directly:
#   npx merv show-logs
#
# Other ways to open the report server:
#   npx merv-client show-report
#   npm run show-report
#   npx merv show-report ./merv-reports
#   npx merv show-report --port 6174
#   npx merv show-report --host 127.0.0.1
#   npx merv show-report --no-open
```

The page loads the **last 100 lines** first; scroll up (or “Load older”) for the previous 100. Live poll only fetches new lines.

Lines with a screenshot show a **camera** icon (and optional 50px thumbnails when **Show screenshots** is checked). Click opens a side panel preview.

Disable file logging: `merv.logger.file=false` or `MervLogger.configure({ file: false })`.

### Combined logs across projects

Hub project (keep `show-report` running, optionally `--host 0.0.0.0`). Other projects:

```properties
merv.log.server=http://127.0.0.1:6174
merv.log.source=checkout-api
# optional remote-only: merv.logger.file=false
```

Env: `MERV_LOG_SERVER`, `MERV_LOG_SOURCE`. Open Merv-Logs on the hub to see all streams.

## Automated setup (`doctor`)

Prefer the package-scoped doctor CLIs — they **create or heal** MERV bits without wiping unrelated settings. Full reference: **[docs/DOCTOR.md](./docs/DOCTOR.md)**.

| Project | Command |
|---------|---------|
| Custom report (this package) | `npx merv-client doctor setup` |
| Playwright Test | `npx merv-client-playwright doctor setup` |
| Cucumber-js | `npx merv-client-cucumber doctor setup` |

```bash
npx merv-client doctor setup
npx merv-client doctor setup --typescript
npx merv-client-playwright doctor setup --typescript
npx merv-client-cucumber doctor setup
```

Then run your tests and open the report:

```bash
npx merv show-report
npx merv-client show-report
npm run show-report

npx merv show-report ./merv-reports
npx merv show-report --port 6174
npx merv show-report --host 127.0.0.1
npx merv show-report --no-open
```

Dashboard: **http://127.0.0.1:6174/** · Merv-Logs: **http://127.0.0.1:6174/merv-logs.html**

## Manual setup (Playwright reporter)

**1.** Add **`merv.properties`** next to `package.json`:

```properties
merv.local=true
merv.regression_suite=My Regression Suite
merv.report.folder=./merv-reports/
```

**2.** Register the reporter using the **`/playwright-reporter`** subpath (avoids double-loading `@playwright/test` when Playwright parses `playwright.config`):

```ts
// playwright.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from '@playwright/test';

export default defineConfig({
  reporter: [
    ['list'],
    ['merv-client/playwright-reporter', {}],
  ],
});
```

Prefer **`merv-client-playwright/reporter`** when that package is installed (same idea).

**3.** Run tests and open **`merv-reports/index.html`** (or `npx merv show-report`).

---

## Keep `import from '@playwright/test'` (Option A)

Use MERV’s wrapped **`test`**, **`MervPlaywrightHandler`**, and plugin-step screenshots while specs still say `@playwright/test`. Full **step-by-step** instructions are in **[FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md §4a](./FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md#4a-option-a-step-by-step-javascript-projects)** (JavaScript) and **[§4b](./FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md#4b-option-a-step-by-step-typescript-projects)** (TypeScript).

**Checklist (JavaScript `.spec.js`):**

| Step | File | Action |
|------|------|--------|
| 1 | `tests/support/playwright-test-bridge.js` | `export * from 'merv-client/playwright-test';` |
| 2 | `playwright.config.js` | `reporter: [['merv-client/playwright-reporter', {}]]` |
| 3 | `jsconfig.json` | `paths`: `@playwright/test` → bridge (valid JSON, no comments) |
| 4 | `package.json` | `"imports": { "@playwright/test": "./tests/support/playwright-test-bridge.js" }` |
| 5 | `tests/*.spec.js` | `import { test, expect, MervPlaywrightHandler } from '@playwright/test';` |
| 6 | Verify | `npx playwright test --list` then `npm test` |

**Checklist (TypeScript `.spec.ts`):**

| Step | File | Action |
|------|------|--------|
| 1 | `tests/support/playwright-test-bridge.ts` | `export { test, expect, … }` + `export type *` from `merv-client/playwright-test` |
| 2 | `tsconfig.json` | Root config for `pages/` + config — **no** `@playwright/test` alias; `"moduleResolution": "bundler"` |
| 3 | `tests/tsconfig.json` | `"extends": "../tsconfig.json"`, `"baseUrl": ".."`, paths → bridge, `"exclude": []` |
| 4 | `playwright.config.ts` | `tsconfig: './tests/tsconfig.json'`; `merv-client/playwright-reporter` in `reporter: []` |
| 5 | `tests/*.spec.ts` | `import { test, expect, MervPlaywrightHandler } from '@playwright/test';` |
| 6 | Verify | `npx tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit` then `npm test` |

**TypeScript IDE tips:** install `typescript` as a devDependency; use **Workspace TypeScript** in VS Code; restart the TS server after editing `tsconfig` files. Do **not** add `"ignoreDeprecations": "6.0"` unless both IDE and CLI use TypeScript 6.

```ts
// tests/support/playwright-test-bridge.ts
export { test, expect, MervPlaywrightHandler } from 'merv-client/playwright-test';
export type * from 'merv-client/playwright-test';
```

```js
// tests/example.spec.js
import { expect, test, MervPlaywrightHandler } from '@playwright/test';

test('demo', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
  const merv = new MervPlaywrightHandler(testInfo);
  await merv.data('Order Id', '12349893', true);
  await page.goto('/');
});
```

Do **not** import `MervPlaywrightHandler` from `merv-client` while `test` comes from stock `@playwright/test` — plugin steps and screenshots will not work.

Other wiring (direct `merv-client` import, `extendTestWithMervScreenshots`) is in **[FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md](./FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md)** §4.

## View local reports (`merv show-report` / `merv show-logs`)

After generating reports, open the dashboard without Live Server or `npx serve`:

```bash
npx merv show-report
# or open Merv-Logs directly:
npx merv show-logs
# or, once merv-client is installed:
merv show-report
merv show-logs
```

Serves `{merv.report.folder}` on **http://127.0.0.1:6174/** (`show-logs` opens `/merv-logs.html`). Ctrl+C stops the server.

```bash
merv show-report ./merv-reports
merv show-logs --port 6174 --no-open
```

---

| Approach | When to use |
|----------|-------------|
| **Reporter only** | Playwright-native steps in MERV JSON/HTML. Import `test` from `@playwright/test`. Playwright `use.screenshot` / `use.video` attachments are included in the MERV report (no bridge required). |
| **Reporter + screenshots (Option A)** | Same imports (`@playwright/test`) via path alias + bridge; see [Screenshots with Option A](#screenshots-with-import-from-playwrighttest-option-a). |
| **`MervPlaywrightHandler`** | You want **full** testcase rows **including** Java-style **`addValidationStep` / `addDataStep` / `info`** merged into the same testcase as Playwright steps. Requires the MERV reporter **and** the usual worker attach wiring (see integration guide). |
| **`MervReport`** | You want to **write MERV output explicitly** (scripts, or Playwright without the reporter). Install **`merv-client` only** — [docs/CUSTOM_REPORT.md](./docs/CUSTOM_REPORT.md) (JS + TS). **No** plugin attach process — calls `createTest`, steps, then `finalize()`. |

## Package entry points

| Import path | Purpose |
|-------------|---------|
| `merv-client` | Core: `MervReport`, `MervLogger`, `MervExplicitLocalReport`, config, Chai, shared steps |
| `merv-client/chai` | Chai plugin helpers |
| `merv-client-playwright/reporter` | Playwright Test reporter (prefer over legacy subpath) |
| `merv-client-playwright/test` | Wrapped `test` / `expect` / `MervPlaywrightHandler` |
| `merv-client-cucumber` | Cucumber-js formatter + `MervReporter` |

Legacy re-exports (when adapter packages are installed): `merv-client/playwright-reporter`, `merv-client/playwright-test`, `merv-client/cucumber-formatter`.

**Custom report (JS/TS):** [docs/CUSTOM_REPORT.md](./docs/CUSTOM_REPORT.md)

## Configuration reference (short)

See **[FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md](./FRAMEWORK_INTEGRATION.md)** for the full table and examples.

| Property | Role |
|----------|------|
| `merv.report.folder` | Root for timestamped run folders (default `./merv-reports/`). |
| `merv.regression_suite` | Suite title in JSON/HTML. |
| `merv.screenshot=true` | Enables wrapped `page` fixture for viewport screenshots after common actions (when using the wrapped `test`). |
| `merv.step.allowed=info,hook,assertion,action` | Only report these step categories; omit any not listed. Overrides `merv.debug` / default filtering when set. |
| `merv.chai=true` | When `chai` is installed, record Chai assertions as MERV `ASSERTION` steps (default on; set `false` to disable). |
| `merv.debug=true` or `debug=true` | Include hooks, fixtures, and all step categories in the report (ignored if `merv.step.allowed` is set). |
| `merv.report.extra_step_types` | Allow tagged `test.step` types when debug is off (e.g. `VALIDATION_STEP`). |
| `merv.plugin_assertion_soft=true` | Record failed validation steps without failing the Playwright test (optional). |

## Migrating from `@techelliptica/merv-client-js`

If you previously depended on the scoped name **only in docs or local `file:` links**, switch to the published package:

```bash
npm uninstall @techelliptica/merv-client-js  # if present
npm install -D merv-client
```

Replace every import and reporter path:

- `@techelliptica/merv-client-js` → `merv-client`
- `@techelliptica/merv-client-js/reporter` → `merv-client/playwright-reporter`
- `@techelliptica/merv-client-js/playwright-test` → `merv-client/playwright-test`

The Git repository folder remains **`merv-client-js/`** inside the MERV monorepo; only the **npm package name** is **`merv-client`**.

---

## Building from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/techelliiptica/merv.git
cd merv/merv-client-js
npm install
npm run build
npm run typecheck
```
